WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cs.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
)
SELECT s.format, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(s.net_amount) sold_net,
  COUNT(r.return_line_id) ret_lines, SUM(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  ROUND(100*SUM(r.refund_net)/SUM(s.net_amount),3) rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > s.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_refund,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_sale,
  MIN(r.return_date), MAX(r.return_date)
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
l AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dd, f.sale_date) bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
a AS (SELECT l.store_id, SUM(net_amount) mine FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.bd WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT r.store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) sid, a.mine, b.ctl, a.mine-b.ctl diff FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id WHERE a.mine IS NULL OR b.ctl IS NULL OR ABS(a.mine-b.ctl)>0.5 ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cs.format
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.format, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) / SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold s
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Small' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
